claim_tested: UMAD1 carries a UMA domain of the MVB12/UBAP1 family
key_finding: Defines UMA domain PROSITE PS51497 / InterPro IPR023340 as the module by which MVB12 and UBAP1 join ESCRT-I
confidence_and_limitations: moderate; review-level and sequence-based, does not test UMAD1 binding

claim_tested: Which MVB12A residues contact the ESCRT-I headpiece
key_finding: Human ESCRT-I headpiece 2.19 A; MVB12A 204-223 in chain A contacts TSG101 263, VPS28 60, VPS37B 56 heavy-atom pairs under 4.5 A; 19/20 modelled residues contact; F220 buries 69 atom pairs
confidence_and_limitations: high for the contact map; only 20 residues of the MVB12A UMA resolved, so UMAD1 95-134 has no experimental interface

claim_tested: How far the fourth subunit extends through ESCRT-I
key_finding: Yeast ESCRT-I is 18 nm, headpiece plus 13 nm stalk, Mvb12 3-81 runs the stalk length
confidence_and_limitations: high; yeast-human differences exist, but shows the fourth subunit is an extended chain

claim_tested: Are MVB12A contact residues conserved in UMAD1
key_finding: UMAD1 47 pct identity at contact face vs 24 pct background, Fisher p=0.0231; UBAP1 positive control 26 pct vs 24 pct, p=0.201; identities V218/V89 P219/P90 F220/F91 T221/T92 L222/L93
confidence_and_limitations: moderate; single-structure projection; gap register ambiguous at MVB12A 211-217 (scores 35 vs 34)

claim_tested: Is the contact face under interface-specific selection
key_finding: contact face 0.723 +/- 0.325 vs rest of protein 0.592 +/- 0.345 (MWU one-sided p=1.89e-02, CLES 0.65); vs rest of UMA 86-134 0.781 +/- 0.319, p=0.590; P90 and F91 invariant in all 150
confidence_and_limitations: moderate; hand-implemented affine NW (BLOSUM62, -11/-1); selected unit is the whole UMA domain

claim_tested: Can the predicted UMAD1 UMA be placed in the ESCRT-I site
key_finding: Kabsch on 18 contact-face CA pairs RMSD 6.29 A; 500 random windows 6.42 +/- 1.10 A, min 4.81, empirical p=0.526; docked UMA 86-134 gives 216 heavy-atom pairs under 2.2 A over 23 residues vs 0 for experimental MVB12A; mean pLDDT 74.8 (86-134), 61.4 (whole)
confidence_and_limitations: high that the test fails, low that failure means anything about binding; unbound monomer cannot be rigid-docked onto a complex-formed conformation; AlphaFold-Multimer not runnable here

claim_tested: Does UMAD1 associate with ESCRT machinery in cells
key_finding: UMAD1 detected in BAC GFP-tagged pulldowns of VPS28, PTPN23, CEP55 and TFG
context: HeLa, BAC transgene GFP bait library, anti-GFP co-IP MS
confidence_and_limitations: low-moderate; proteome-scale, bait-side only, no reciprocal pulldown

claim_tested: Is there any direct UMAD1-TSG101 or UMAD1-VPS37 record
key_finding: 16 binary evidences for C9J7I0 vs 62 MVB12A, 25 MVB12B, 19 UBAP1; none involve TSG101, VPS37A-D, MVB12A or MVB12B; others GABARAPL1 and TH isoform 3 (PMID 32296183), RBCK1 TNIP1 BIRC2 TRAF2 (PMID 30561431)
confidence_and_limitations: moderate; absence of evidence is weak but TSG101 and VPS37A are heavily assayed baits

claim_tested: Do UMA-containing subunits select among VPS37 paralogs
key_finding: UBAP1 complex contains a fraction of cellular TSG101 and VPS37A but not VPS37C; binds HD-PTP not Alix; required for EGFR sorting not cytokinesis
confidence_and_limitations: high for the UBAP1 claim; shows ESCRT-I exists as distinct subcomplexes

claim_tested: How much is annotated for UMAD1
key_finding: C9J7I0 reviewed, PE level 1, 137 aa, 0 GO cross-references, 4 references; MVB12A 21 GO, MVB12B 18, UBAP1 10, VPS37A-D 12-19, TSG101 42, VPS28 19
confidence_and_limitations: high; a curation gap, not a negative functional result

claim_tested: Does UMAD1 localize like an ESCRT-I subunit
key_finding: UMAD1 nucleoplasm only, no vesicle term; MVB12A MVB12B UBAP1 VPS37A VPS37C VPS37D VPS28 all report vesicles; UMAD1 RNA tissue specificity low, like MVB12A UBAP1 VPS37A-D
confidence_and_limitations: low; TSG101 also lacks a vesicle term, one unvalidated UMAD1 antibody

claim_tested: Is UMAD1 too recent to be a real subunit
confidence_and_limitations: moderate; gene-name counts not orthology; vertebrate restriction shared with confirmed subunit MVB12A

claim_tested: Do human genetics data implicate UMAD1 protein function
key_finding: UMAD1 appears in GWAS and methylation studies with no protein-level follow-up
confidence_and_limitations: low; locus shared with RPA3 (aliases RPA3-AS1, RPA3OS), signals not attributable to UMAD1 protein
